---
name: Report an incident
about: An AI coding agent caused real damage, and there is a public source for it
labels: incident-report
---

**Source (required).** A public link: GitHub issue or PR, security advisory, vendor post-mortem, or a first-hand write-up. We cannot publish an incident without one.

**Agent and version.** e.g. Claude Code 2.1.x, Cursor 3.x, Codex CLI.

**Platform and setup.** OS, shell, permission or auto-approve mode, sandbox on or off.

**What it was asked to do.**

**What it actually did.** Commands, if known.

**Damage.** What was lost, leaked or broken, and whether it was recovered.
